anomalies.observed: On the right-hand servo sheet the two channel resistors are drawn in series in a single row: PWM1 -> R3 (1k) -> R13 (0R/'R130') -> J3 pin 3, and PWM2 -> R4 (1k) -> R14 (0R/'R140') -> J8 pin 3. The signal path from the PWM net to the servo header signal pin therefore passes through BOTH the 1k resistor and the 0R servo-mode jumper, with the TTL/MAX3485 bus tapped on the R3/R13 (and R4/R14) junction.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification R3/R4 must land directly on J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3, and R13/R14 must be a separate parallel 0R bridge from those same pins onto the MAX3485 TTL bus, so that PWM mode works with R13/R14 left OPEN and serial mode works by shorting R13/R14. The schematic note itself ('Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo') implies the jumpers are only closed for serial use.

evidence.quote: PWM mode (populate R3/R4, and the appropriate R9-R12 pair ... ; leave R13/R14 open): each servo header's signal pin gets its own independent 1 kOhm-buffered GPIO line (/PWM1 -> J3 pin3, /PWM2 -> J8 pin3) straight from the M5Stack bus.
R13, R14 | 0 Ohm (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus
PWM1  1k R3  R13(0)  J3  Conn_01x03 ; annotation 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo'

anomalies.impact: With the 0R jumpers left open as the specification's assembly procedure requires for PWM mode, J3 pin 3 and J8 pin 3 would be left floating and PWM servos would receive no control signal. In serial mode, populating R3/R4 would additionally tie the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets onto the shared TTL servo bus through 1k. The jumper-selectable PWM/serial scheme therefore no longer behaves as documented.

parsed.summary: All component values match the specification, but the servo-signal jumper network appears wrong: R13/R14 are drawn in series with R3/R4 between the PWM nets and the servo signal pins instead of being independent 0R bridges from J3.3/J8.3 to the MAX3485 TTL bus, which would leave the servo signal pins disconnected in PWM mode (where the specification says R13/R14 must be left open).
